plain: A person who does wrong; a criminal

webster.text: One who commits a crime; one guilty of violating the laws, in such a manner as to subject him to public prosecution and punishment, particularly to capital punishment; a criminal.

example.quote: To pardon a malefactor may be a favor, but the pardon is not, on that account, the less irrevocable.
example.cite: James Madison, Report on the Virginia Resolutions (Report of 1800), Jan. 7, 1800
